issue_context.title: Segfault in EVP_PKEY_sign_init_ex with RSA_PKCS1_PSS_PADDING
comments:
Hi all,

I seem to have a version that does work. By not specifying the padding to `EVP_PKEY_sign_init_ex`, but instead leaving that `NULL` and specifying the padding through `EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_params` does work. Afterwards I'm able to generate a valid signature.

Is this intended behaviour? If so, what are the difference between the parameters set through these two functions?

Thanks!

Best regards,
SpoofedEx
This is a bug in the provider implementation.
